maddeler.e:
أتيامن (form VI)
# أَتَيَامَنُ (ʔatayāmanu) /ʔa.ta.jaː.ma.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَيَامَنَ (tayāmana)
# أَتَيَامَنَ (ʔatayāmana) /ʔa.ta.jaː.ma.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَيَامَنَ (tayāmana)
# أَتَيَامَنْ (ʔatayāman) /ʔa.ta.jaː.man/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَيَامَنَ (tayāmana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
